description.value:
“Corpo megatowers use pretty hefty nails to keep their foundations secure, and the crews building ‘em don’t always get the budget for more FBCs to keep up with quota. So a while back, some techheads working on a Techtronika tower put an overclocked railgun frame onto an actual nailgun, which the corp then copied into this brute. It jams like hell, and moves like sewage, but it charges quick and leaves one hell of a mark.”

Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Poor Quality Crossbow • Skill: Archery • Range: Shortbow

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 1 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Supercharger, Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Cannot load Ammunition that does not deal damage (e.g., Arrowhypo, Sleep, etc.) or has a poison-related effect (e.g., Biotoxin, Poison, etc.). This weapon’s Tech Rebuild only requires sacrificing half of the user’s MOVE (round down) to be charged. This must be done before the user has used any MOVE in their Turn [Supercharger]. Requires BODY 11+ or paired Cyberarms to not incur a -1 penalty to DEX and MOVE while wielded. Whenever this weapon jams, it requires 2 Actions to clear the jam before it can be fired again.

Range: Shortbow
Pre-installed: Supercharger, Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
